scientific_integrity: All face and boundary computations are reproduced from the standalone checker, with a separately implemented independent face enumeration. No independence of mathematical review is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite reduced homology over F_2 for 3<=r<=10 only; integral torsion, homotopy type and behavior for r>10 are not established; highest degree 2r known from earlier general theorem.
title: First five-degree mod-two multipath homology support in fully bidirected wheel graphs
